hypothesis: Putting H3 video latents and LIBERO actions on one physical temporal contract improves clean val40 action loss by at least 0.25 percentage points beyond E24 while preserving positive video improvement.
single_variable: Replace ordinal 12-video-frame to 8-action-chunk mapping and action RoPE 0..7.75 with H3 physical-time mapping derived from the released non-uniform 5/3*(1,4,4,4,4) rotary grid and the cache's 33-to-39 nearest-neighbour resampling. E24 data, q01/q99 normalization, initialization, seed, optimizer and single action timestep remain fixed.
parent_baseline: E24 quantile s100: clean val40 action/video 1.295573/0.166345, action improvement 0.676% from identical initialization.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.rationale: Backbone port is fixed across E24 and E28.

data.local: 33 source observations and 32 actions resampled to 39 H3 target frames / 12 latents
data.rationale: Both modalities cover the same 1.6-second LIBERO interval.

action.paper: action chunks follow generated world chunks
action.upstream_code: action positions are fractional coordinates inside the same latent-frame clock
action.local: action coordinates are mapped through the 33-to-39 resampling onto H3's non-uniform rotary clock
action.rationale: This removes the prior text-origin and ordinal-time mismatch while retaining H3's native geometry.

objective.local: same E24 video plus action velocity MSE

optimization.local: 100 steps, global batch8, first 800 windows, lr1e-6, warmup10, tail-2
optimization.rationale: Small paired experiment before expensive training.

evaluation.local: episode-disjoint val40, then no-leak sample40 and rollout only after threshold

evidence: fixed LingBot commit and deployed H3 source
physical-time stage restored for val8; finite action/video 1.235643/0.150992

decision.rationale: Run real 2-step smoke and restore first. If finite, train s100. Promote to causal sample40 only if clean action improvement versus initialization is at least 0.926% (E24 0.676% plus 0.25 percentage points) and video remains positively improved. Otherwise stop without rollout.
